name: Local Prospecting Tool
author: Codesert Technolab

sections.description:
EASILITY FIND LOCAL BUSINESSES BY ENTERING LOCATION

Introducing the “Local Prospecting Tool” plugin, your ultimate solution for effortlessly discovering local businesses right from your WordPress site. Powered by the robust Google Maps API, this innovative tool revolutionizes how you uncover nearby businesses, making it easier than ever to connect with potential clients and partners.

With the Local Prospecting Tool, simply enter your desired location and customize your search radius to pinpoint businesses within your target area. Additionally, leverage the new industry field feature to filter results based on specific industry keywords. Whether you’re searching for restaurants, real estate agencies, or tech startups, this plugin enables you to narrow down your search to find businesses that align with your needs.

But that’s not all – the Local Prospecting Tool goes the extra mile by offering seamless integration with your WordPress site. It’s designed to be intuitive and user-friendly, ensuring that you can harness its power without any technical expertise.

This plugin isn’t just about discovery – it’s about empowering you with actionable insights. Once you’ve found the businesses you’re interested in, easily export the data into a convenient CSV format for further analysis. Whether you’re compiling leads, conducting market research, or building a network of local contacts, this feature simplifies the process and puts valuable information at your fingertips.

Local Prospecting Tool Features

  • Effortlessly find local businesses using the Local Prospecting Tool.
  • Customize search radius to target specific areas.
  • Filter search results based on industry keywords.
  • Export search results to CSV for easy data management and analysis.

Experience the power of the Local Prospecting Tool and unlock new opportunities right from your WordPress site. Download now and start exploring the wealth of local businesses waiting to be discovered!

Third-Party Service Usage

The plugin relies on a third-party service, Google Places API, to provide certain features. This service is used under the following circumstances:

  • Google Places API used to get location and business data feature.
  • Using this service we’re fetching list of data which is main feature of the plugin.

Service Details

  • Service Name: Google Places API
  • Service Description: The Places API is a service that accepts HTTP requests for location data through a variety of methods. It returns formatted location data and imagery about establishments, geographic locations, or prominent points of interest.
  • Service Link: Click to visit!
  • Terms of Use: Click to visit!
  • Privacy Policy: Click to visit!

By using Local Prospecting Tool, you acknowledge and agree to the terms of use and privacy policy of Google Place API. Please review their policies for more information on how your data is handled.
sections.faq:
How does the Local Prospecting Tool work?

The Local Prospecting Tool utilizes the Google Maps API to search for and display local businesses based on the location entered by the user. Users can customize the search radius to narrow down the results according to their preferences. Additionally, users can now enter specific industry keywords to filter results based on their industry of interest.

Is the plugin easy to install and set up?

Absolutely! The Local Prospecting Tool is designed to be user-friendly and can be easily installed like any other WordPress plugin. Once installed, simply add Google Maps API key and plugin is ready to rock!

Can I search for businesses in specific industries or categories?

Yes, with the latest update, the Local Prospecting Tool allows users to enter industry keywords to filter search results based on their industry of interest. This feature enables users to find businesses that align with their specific needs and preferences.

What format is the exported data available in?

The Local Prospecting Tool allows users to export search results into a CSV (Comma Separated Values) format, which can be easily opened and manipulated in spreadsheet software such as Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

Does the plugin require any additional API keys or subscriptions?

Yes, the plugin requires a Google Maps API key for accessing the mapping data. You can obtain an API key from the Google Cloud Platform and configure it within the plugin settings.

Is the plugin compatible with all WordPress themes and versions?

The Local Prospecting Tool is designed to be compatible with most WordPress themes and versions. However, we recommend using it with the latest version of WordPress for optimal performance and compatibility.
